entries.def: to make small or fine: to thresh out, winnow , [variant datesAnthology Palantina:—;Pass. to be reduced, grow lean , (Aristotle Philosopher); τοὺς ὤμους λεπτύνεσθαι (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

1. a place where people assembled to talk and hear news, a lounge, club-room , (Odyssey by Homer), etc.: —;also a council-hall, council , (Aeschulus Tragicus) 
2. talk or gossip , such as went on in the λέσχαι, (Euripides):—; in good sense, conversation, discussion , (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)
to have white blossoms : generally, to be white or made white , (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

1. white leprosy , (Herdotus Historicus), etc. 
2. the white poplar , Lat. populus alba, (Aristophanes Comicus) (ML)

anything received, income , (Aeschulus Tragicus); λ. καὶ ἀνάλωμα receipt and expense, (Plato Philosophus): generally, gain, profit , Lat. lucrum, (Sophocles Tragicus), etc.; παντὸς ἥττων λήμματος unable to resist any temptation of gain , (Demosthenes Orator); often in plural, (Demosthenes Orator) (ML)
